acceptance: Red test first: the four failure blocks of cycle 2035 as fixtures; round 1 returns stop with the reason handoff_blocker and names M1 and the console item retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-lane-ac-5-console.
A failure block with only lane findings (the H1 helper fix alone) returns no stop and lists the lane findings.
A hand-off finding that does not block (M2, MEDIUM, no gate failure) is in the hand-off list and does not cause a stop.
The stop decision carries the salvage pointer, the findings and the console item that the seal records.
workflow.repair.fixability.stage is a strict stage key (off, shadow, enforce; default shadow).
fix: Add a pure package fixability that reads the failure block (defects, prescriptions, evidence paths) and the ship and gate failures. A finding is hand-off when it cites a path for which guards.IsProtectedSurface is true or names an open console inbox item. It blocks when a deterministic gate fails on it, the audit proves a red test on it (as the round 1 overlay proof of M1), or its severity is HIGH or above. The result is lane findings, hand-off findings and a stop decision with the salvage fields. Add the stage key.
